VBO:0200028.summary: Rascal’s keeper described a vigilant but loving four-year-old who obeyed commands and chased trespassing varmints. Another owner reported that five-year-old Capone knew more than 50 verbal commands and 20 signs. American Bandogge accounts cover varied crosses: Rascal’s father was a Great Dane and his mother a Pit Bull–Neapolitan Mastiff cross, while Capone was an English Mastiff–Pit Bull cross.
VBO:0200028.shortDescription: Named Bandogges include vigilant, affectionate Rascal and Capone, whose owner reported a large verbal and sign vocabulary.
